$description: Mez Systems design tokens. Surface V1 locked 2026-07-12 (ONE surface system, not five); type locked 2026-07-10. Mirrors tokens.css and DESIGN_SYSTEM.md.

bg.note: page background / brand white, never pure #FFFFFF

text.note: primary text, headings, mark; also dark UI / buttons / bundles

textMuted.note: captions, meta (WCAG AA ~4.6:1 on #F8F8F8; raised from 0.58 2026-07-17)

error.note: form errors / invalid / destructive; forms + feedback only

success.note: form success / confirmed; forms + feedback only

focusRing.note: focus ring on LIGHT surfaces, at least 3:1 against #F8F8F8 and #FFFFFF, 2px width, 2px offset. Maps to --mz-focus-ring.

focusRingDark.note: focus ring on DARK sections, 2px width, 2px offset. Maps to --mz-focus-ring-dark.

inputBorder.note: form-control boundary, at least 3:1 against white and light surfaces. Maps to --mz-input-border.

placeholder.note: placeholder text, at least 4.5:1 against white and light surfaces. Maps to --mz-placeholder.

productAssets.$note: Exact bundled files. CSS resolves these relative to tokens/tokens.css; no Figma access or synthetic fallback is required.

darkSurface.$note: Text + border tokens for #0D0D0D dark sections. A section treatment, not a theme (see docs/12-states-and-forms.md). Maps to --mz-dark-* in tokens.css.

muted.note: muted text, captions, meta on dark

font.note: Default=Inter, Serif=Instrument Serif (editorial accent, sparingly), Mono=IBM Plex Mono. Notion-inspired.

h1.$note: Fluid clamp: clamp(44px, 6vw, 72px), matches --mz-h1-size in tokens.css.

radius.$note: Component radius scale (V1, locked 2026-07-12). Maps to --mz-r-* in tokens.css.

radiusBrandTier.$note: Radius encodes entity scale (separate namespace). Maps to --mz-radius-pill/holdco/parent.

space.$note: 4px base. Steps 1-8 are the component scale; steps 9-11 are section steps for page rhythm (see docs/11-layout-and-grid.md). Maps to --mz-s-1 … --mz-s-11 in tokens.css.

layout.$note: Page geometry (see docs/11-layout-and-grid.md). Container centred; gutter 24px below 920, 32px at 920 and up. Maps to --mz-container / --mz-gutter / --mz-gutter-lg.

breakpoints.$note: Min-width px. sm mobile→tablet, md tablet→desktop (gutter widens, section padding steps up), lg wide (suite grid four-up).

motion.$note: One duration, one easing, hover only (see docs/16-motion.md). durationSlow = accordion + mobile nav sheet only. Maps to --mz-duration / --mz-duration-slow / --mz-ease. prefers-reduced-motion:reduce disables all transforms.

sizing.$note: Locked sizing ratios (2026-07-12, glow retired 2026-07-17). All proportional, not fixed pixels. Reproduce by ratio at any size. See DESIGN_SYSTEM.md section 8.

disc.note: The standard product treatment. Hard edge, no halo.

productCard.$note: Orb diameter = 50% of the card width.

tradingCard.$note: Portrait 3:4, radius = 7.5% of width, white 16% inner hairline. Top-left dark glass eyebrow chip 'MEZ SYSTEMS' inset ~8% of width. Bottom-third lockup: white wings (32% of width) above the name (white Semi Bold), name bottom padding ~9% of height. No floating centred lockup.

retired.glow: Retired 2026-07-17. Halo ratios removed; never build halos.
